items.title: Remember the special BIMCO clauses for US and China port fees
items.summary:
Recent reports indicate that the reciprocal port fee measures introduced by the United States and China may remain suspended until 10 January 2027. If confirmed, this would remove the immediate prospect of the fees being reintroduced in November 2026.
However, uncertainty remains both as to the long
items.summary_zh: 美國與中國的互惠港口費用措施可能維持暫停至2027年1月10日。若此情況得到確認，則原定於2026年11月重新實施的費用將不會出現。然而，長期情況仍存在不確定性。

items.title: Are skill gaps in your team costing you time and money?
items.summary:
Standard training courses do not always address the specific challenges your staff encounter in their day-to-day work.
BIMCO’s customised inhouse training takes a different approach.
Rather than adapting your needs to an existing course, you can work with BIMCO to determine the objectives, topics, d
items.summary_zh: 標準培訓課程未必能針對員工日常工作遇到的具體挑戰。BIMCO 提供客製化內部培訓，採取不同的方式。您可以與 BIMCO 合作，決定培訓目標與內容。

items.title: Unlocking the full value of vessel data: BIMCO's Energy Efficiency Data Sharing Clause 2025
items.summary: Every ship generates a significant amount of operational and performance data. When appropriate arrangements are in place, this data can support a range of activities, including vessel performance monitoring, voyage optimisation, weather routing, and other energy efficiency initiatives to the benefi
items.summary_zh: 每艘船舶都會產生大量運營與性能數據。當具備適當安排時，這些數據可用於船舶性能監測、航程優化、氣象航線規劃及其他節能措施。

items.title: BIMCO Symposium highlights need for global maritime security co-operation
items.summary: Geopolitical tensions, regional conflicts and increasingly sophisticated criminal networks are creating connected security risks for international shipping. At BIMCO’s Maritime Security Symposium 2026, participants agreed that preparedness, trusted information sharing and closer co-operation are ess
items.summary_zh: 地緣政治緊張、區域衝突及日益複雜的犯罪網絡正在為國際航運創造相互關聯的安全風險。在 BIMCO 2026 年海事安全研討會上，與會者一致認為，做好準備、可信的資訊共享以及更緊密的合作是必須的。

items.title: BIMCO updates its open source eBL Standard to support the next stage of digital trade
items.summary: We have updated our electronic bill of lading standard (eBL Standard) for the bulk shipping sector, supporting the industry’s transition from paper to digital trade documentation.
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 已更新其適用於散貨航運領域的電子提單 (eBL) 開源標準，以支援航運業從紙本文件轉向數位貿易文件的下一階段發展。

items.title: Join the sounding board for the revision of BIMCO's Electronic Bills of Lading Clause
items.summary:
BIMCO is seeking industry participants to join a sounding board and provide feedback on the first draft of the new BIMCO Electronic Bills of Lading Clause.
The updated clause aims to reflect current market practice and the growing use of electronic trade documentation. The objective is to ensure tha

items.title: BIMCO clauses now available directly within Sea's contract workflow
items.summary: Sea and BIMCO have expanded their collaboration to bring BIMCO's standard clauses directly into Sea's fixture workflow.
items.summary_zh: Sea 與 BIMCO 擴大合作。BIMCO 標準條款現在可直接於 Sea 的固定作業流程中使用。

items.title: The IMO GHG working group – a BIMCO account
items.summary: From 1-4 September 2026, the 22nd meeting of the intersessional working group on reduction of greenhouse gases from shipping took place at the IMO Headquarters in London. We were represented throughout the full week. Below is an account of the discussions, potential and hurdles following a week of i
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月1日至4日，第22次IMO溫室氣體減排工作組會議在倫敦IMO總部舉行。BIMCO全程參與。會議討論了船舶溫室氣體減減的潛力與挑戰。

items.title: Global Shipping Business Network appoints BIMCO to its board
items.summary: Global Shipping Business Network (GSBN) is a neutral, not-for-profit consortium enabling paperless, accessible and sustainable global trade.
items.summary_zh: Global Shipping Business Network (GSBN) 是一個中立、非營利的 consortium。其目標是推動無紙化、便利且永續的全球貿易。

items.title: Help BIMCO Shape the Future of Biofouling Management
items.summary: BIMCO is seeking industry feedback on practical experience with the 2023 IMO Biofouling Guidelines as the IMO considers details of a mandatory Convention. The survey gathers insights on implementation, effectiveness and operational challenges and forms part of a wider BIMCO evidence-gathering initia
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 正在蒐集業界對 2023 年 IMO 生物附著管理指南實務經驗的回饋，作為 IMO 研議制定具強制力公約之依據。本次調查涵蓋執行現況、有效性及作業面挑戰，並屬於 BIMCO 整體證據蒐集工作的一部分。

items.title: Your input needed on new Virtual Notice of Readiness Clause for Voyage Charter Parties
items.summary:
We are developing a new Virtual Notice of Readiness and Just in Time Arrival Clause for Voyage Charter Parties aimed at supporting more efficient voyage execution while addressing some of the legal and commercial barriers to Just in Time (JIT) operations. 
We are looking to provide a contractual fra
items.summary_zh: 相關機構正研擬新的航次租船合約「虛擬備便通知 (Virtual NOR)」與「準時抵達 (JIT)」條款，旨在提升航次執行效率並解決 JIT 作業的法律與商業障礙。目前正徵詢業界對此合約框架之意見。

items.title: BIMCO seeks industry input on contractual gaps from Gulf disruption
items.summary: For months, ships and their crews have been facing extremely difficult and challenging circumstances in the Persian Gulf. Following the outbreak of hostilities in late February 2026 and the subsequent severe drop in traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, many ships already inside the Gulf have been u
items.summary_zh: 波斯灣衝突於 2026 年 2 月下旬爆發後，荷莫兹海峽通行量大幅下降，許多滯留於波斯灣內的船舶面臨嚴峻情況。為此 BIMCO 正就現行契約條款在戰爭風險與航行中斷情境下的適用性徵集業界意見，探討是否需要在標準合約中新增或修訂條款來因應此類區域性衝突所衍生的合約空隙。

items.title: HNS Convention set to enter into force in November 2027
items.summary: The international maritime regime for liability and compensation following incidents involving hazardous and noxious substances is set to change when the International Convention on Liability and Compensation for Damage in connection with the Carriage of Hazardous and Noxious Substances by Sea enter
items.summary_zh: 《1996 年國際海上運輸有害及有毒物質造成損害之責任與賠償公約》(HNS 公約) 預定於 2027 年 11 月生效。該公約規範危險及有毒物質 (HNS) 海上運輸造成損害時的責任與賠償制度,生效後將對裝載 HNS 貨物的船舶及營運人產生新的法律與保險義務。船東需提前檢視船舶是否裝載 HNS 貨物、準備相關文件,並評估對責任險與強制保險要求的影響。

items.title: Leadership Perspective: BIMCO Strategy 2026
items.summary: This article by BIMCO Secretary General and CEO David Loosley was originally sent to the CEOs of all BIMCO member companies and organisations on 29 July 2026.
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 秘書長兼執行長 David Loosley 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日向所有 BIMCO 會員公司與組織的執行長發送 BIMCO 2026 策略展望文章。內容聚焦協會層級的策略方向與領導階層觀點。

items.title: New member benefit: weekly freight market assessments from Platts S&P Global Energy
items.summary: If you are a BIMCO member, you can now access weekly freight market assessments from Platts S&P Global Energy on our website.
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 會員現在可在其網站上取得 Platts S&P Global Energy 每週貨運市場評估資料。
